# awscc_connect_use_case (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Connect::UseCase



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `instance_id` (String) The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.
- `integration_association_id` (String) The identifier for the integration association.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags used to organize, track, or control access for this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `use_case_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the use case.
- `use_case_id` (String) The identifier of the use case.
- `use_case_type` (String) The type of use case to associate to the integration association.
